property.name: quoteId
property.label: Quote Id
property.description: Id of the parent Quote (required by the save/reprice engine).

property.name: quoteLineItemId
property.label: Quote Line Item Id
property.description: Id of the root configurable QuoteLineItem being configured.

property.name: autoApplyDefault
property.label: Auto-apply changes by default
property.description: If checked (default), a clean proposal is applied automatically without a manual Apply click. The rep can toggle this off in the panel. Invalid/ambiguous/low-confidence proposals always fall back to review.

property.name: showSentToConfigurator
property.label: Show 'Sent to configurator' card
property.description: If checked, an itemized confirmation card appears after each apply. Default off — auto-apply confirms via the chat message alone. Enable per screen via a Flow variable.
